title: Lansdale has Yamashita's driver tortured to find 12 troves

tellings.quote: troves are there. So what he does is he he kidnaps the driver for General Yakushima who would know where the some of them were, right?

plain: A lawyer and researcher, Dan Sheehan, tells on Jesse Michels's podcast that in Manila in the Philippines in 1945, a man named Ed Lansdale kidnapped the driver of General Yamashita, believing the driver knew where some of a dozen hidden troves were buried. Sheehan says the driver was tortured to give up those locations, with a figure called Santa Romana also involved. If true, it would tie secret wartime treasure to the people later said to run hidden programs.
